value.answer: Call 911 now. Fast breathing, ribs pulling in and dusky lips mean your child may not be getting enough oxygen. Stay with them and keep them calm and upright until help arrives.
value.triage: Call 911 now - don't wait to see if it passes. Don't call 811 first; 811 is for non-emergencies. If you can't get an ambulance, go to the nearest ER right now.
